notes.title: Extra Play Test for ASURAJANG
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1199274206240710717/1238020667031556177/ETP5_-_.png?ex=663e6cd8&is=663d1b58&hm=766915f0ebb60dcebc2972de55999a8e8da24f157295513793ba5294951433e3&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=822&height=462[/img]

We will be holding an ឵Extra Play Test for ASURAJANG this Friday.

 ឵Time & Date: May 10th, (Fri.) 19:00~23:00 (GMT+9)
 ឵Server: Korea 
      This availability of the test is guaranteed only for specific regions as it is being held for testing purposes. 
      If you are connecting from a region other than Korea and Japan, you may experience connection and translation issues.
      Thank you for patience and understanding.

The ASURAJANG team has been working hard to participate in the June 2024 Edition of STEAM Next Fest.
We will be holding an Extra Play Test to allow our Asura Community to participate in our dev tests.

We are aware that many of you in the Asura Community are excited to see how much has changed since the last CBT,
so we are providing an opportunity for players to play ASURAJANG before STEAM Next Fest.
You can play with the devs in this Extra Play Test and experience the improvements in the latest build!

※ The Extra Play Test build is still under development. Some menus and features may not be available and changes may be made in future builds.
※ Officially supported languages for this build are limited to Korean and Japanese. 
   English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese translations are currently under progress,
   and will be available in the STEAM Next Fest build.
※ Some Asuras do not have voice lines yet. These will also be added for the STEAM Next Fest build.
※ The above schedule is subject to change or cancellation due to the studio's circumstances.

notes.title: 12/20 CBT Update patch note
notes.notes:
[b]12/20 CBT Update patch note
[/b]
[b]A full set of Legendary Akashas will be distributed to players.[/b]
[olist]
[*]In order to test Akasha stats, we are giving all players a set of Legendary Akashas that have been upgraded to the Max Level. (*Complete one game session to unlock a reward. Check your missions after playing).
[/olist]
[b]The following Balance Changes were made./b]
[olist]
[*]Slightly increased the rotation speed of Bharata's Ultimate Action.
[*]Bharata's Ultimate Action beam DMG was increased by 10%.
[*]Bharata's Normal Action DMG was increased by 10%.
[*]Bharata's Special Action DMG was increased by 20%.
[*]All Robe Astras now provide increased Max HP.
[*]All Mask Astras now provide increased DMG Reduction.
[*]Baju's Extra Action - Somersault Kick DMG was reduced by approximately 10%.
[*]Baju's Extra Action - Somersault Kick Hit-box Height was reduced from 4 m to 3 m.
[*]Baju's Aerial Normal Action DMG was reduced by approximately 10%.
[*]Super Armor was added to Deung-O's Special Action, towards the start of the animation.
[*]Deung-O's Extra Action Hit 2 DMG was reduced by approximately 10%.
[*]Deung-O's Extra Action now has Super Armor from the start of the animation.
[*]Payra's Aerial Extra Action DMG was reduced by approximately 10%.
[*]Ryuan's Aerial Normal Action Hit 1 & 2 DMG was reduced by approximately 10%.
[*]Ryuan's Dodge - Weave Stamina Cost was increased by 10%.
[/olist]
[b]The following Bugs were also fixed.[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fixed some terrain where players were getting stuck and couldn't get out from.
[/olist]

[u][b]Exit the Steam client and open Steam again to start update process.[/b][/u]

notes.title: 12/17 CBT Update patch note
notes.notes:
[b]12/17 CBT Update patch note[/b]
[b]Some Actions were adjusted because they were causing unintended combat experiences in various situations.[b]
[olist]
[*]Common: 'Stumble' animations can be canceled slightly faster.
[*]Made minor adjustments to the landing animation cancel timing when hit by Pyra's Aerial Extra Action to fix an issue that allowed her Aerial Extra Action to be chained indefinitely. 
[*]Reduced the stun duration of Deung-O's Dodge Attack from 2 s to 1 s, fixing an issue where Dodge Attack stuns could be chained indefinitely.
[*]Deung-O's Dodge Attack DMG was increased by 20%.
[*]Slightly reduced the length of recovery animations for Deung-O's Extra and Aerial Extra Action.
[*]Bharata now stays in the air if the Safe Zone shrinks while her Ultimate Action is being used.
[*]Reduced the maximum range of Muimui's Extra Action from 17 m to 15 m.
[*]Slightly reduced the recovery animation duration after Hanuman's Ultimate Action fails to hit a target.
[*]Yuan Extra and Aerial Extra Action's Stamina Cost was reduced from 320 to 300.
[*]Yuan's 'Dark Flames' buff duration was increased from 10 s to 12 s.
[*]The following bugs were also fixed.
[*]Fixed a bug where Muimui would shoot in the opposite direction when using her Normal Action while close to an enemy.
[/olist]

[b]The following bugs were also fixed.[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where Muimui would shoot in the opposite direction when using her Normal Action while close to an enemy.
[*]Fixed a bug where the remaining party members would also be disconnected when a party member disconnected.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the client to crash intermittently.
[/olist]

[u][b]Exit the Steam client and open Steam again to start update process.[/b][/u]
